svg.title: Travel TVB — Microservice Architecture (High-Level Overview)
svg.desc: High-level architecture: React SPA frontend talks to Kong API Gateway, which routes to six microservices (Identity, Catalog, Booking, Payment, Content, AI Chatbot). Each service owns its data store (PostgreSQL, ChromaDB, or Redis). Domain events flow asynchronously through a RabbitMQ message broker. External integrations: VNPay sandbox and the Google Gemini API.

g.text: High-level overview · 6 services behind a Kong gateway · RabbitMQ event bus
DB-less mode · JWT validation · request routing & rewrites · X-User-Id / X-User-Role injection
AMQP :5672 · Management UI :15672 · Durable topic exchanges
